primary_benchmark.formula: recorded_prompt_candidate_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens; workload_token_savings_pct = (full_tokens - arm_tokens) / full_tokens * 100

simulated_task_trajectory_turnaround_ms.methodology: Monte Carlo convolution over empirical attempts (10,000 samples, seed=42)

retrieval_diagnostics.description: Inductive LSA and Lexical TF-IDF diagnostic recall on 32 tasks vs 27 schema chunks with normalized gold targets

cross_schema_stress_test.study_characterization: Deterministic simulation-based mechanism stress test (word/punctuation heuristic token estimates)

provenance.study_characterization: Deterministic simulation-based mechanism stress test using whitespace/punctuation heuristic token counts. Both full and lasr_reactive arms share identical modeled structural and recovery outcomes (16/32 first-pass, 32/32 final structural, 30/32 semantic). Reported savings represent token reduction under matched simulated completion outcomes.
provenance.evaluation_regime: 4 synthetic enterprise schemas, 8 tasks each (4 explicit, 4 ambiguous), 2 arms (full vs lasr_reactive), N=64 records total

langgraph_counterfactual.characterization: Counterfactual state-history accumulation token model (+45 tok compiler context)

paired_delta.permutation_test_type: Monte Carlo one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test

cluster_dependence_sensitivity.sensitivity_disclosure: Task-level significance (p < 0.001) reflects paired comparisons across 32 template-family tasks. However, equal-weighting across the 4 semantic clusters and exhaustively testing all 16 sign flips yields mean delta +0.6125 with exact one-sided p = 0.125. This confirms that inference is sensitive to the unit of analysis, and evidence supports predictive accuracy within this held-out template family with recurring constraint bundles rather than general semantic generalization.

overlap_analysis.scientific_characterization: Train and test sets are partitioned by template families (A/B train vs C test). There is 103/149 (69.1%) vocabulary overlap due to shared enterprise procurement terminology. All 4 target constraint combinations recur across train and test families.
